set.body:
Current plan: docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md, Full event-graph delivery. Owner approved proceeding 2026-11-16.

Scope: Reuse checked temporal semantics and exact native/presentation support. Treat source presentation order, story-world chronology and recall order as different axes. An undeclared world clock stays unknown; a topological ordering or interval overlap is not evidence of a causal relation.

Engineering acceptance artifact: One temporal witness artifact admits each declared relation with its coordinate/evidence basis and distinguishes intersects from Allen Overlaps, flashback presentation from world order, unknown ordering and inconsistent constraints; substituted axes or unsupported world-time assertions are refused or gap explicitly.

Scope is one bounded synthetic account and its public path, not a whole-corpus extraction. Use repository reference-scope gates, relevant mutation/compile-refusal evidence and exact-SHA cold review. Graph-wide integration and fresh-data qualification remain on the existing E0 and human-evaluation tickets. Claim this slice, not a parent container.
set.title: [event-graph] Produce explicit temporal relations without inventing chronology
